title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：philosophy　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 philosophy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the painter ① taught the philosophy that no visitor in the studio would have noted, and he said the teaching was the whole of the season. The ② philosophy, meaning the thought itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; philosophy, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of philosophy in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ philosophy at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Philosophy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the painter said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the philosophy was the whole of the matter, meaning the wisdom and not the thought. The ⑥ philosophy, meaning the wisdom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; philosophy, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both thought and a wisdom. He said the wisdom is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ philosophy had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ philosophy of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of noting; philosophy, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ philosophy I remember is the philosophy noted in the catalogue, which closed in 1964 and is still noted as the quietest in the studio. ⑩ Philosophy, my mother said in 1966, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all philosophy, she said, is a wisdom that has agreed to look like thought. She said the wisdom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 哲学；人生哲学（指画室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 哲学；人生哲学（指那门哲学本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the philosophy 讲授这一门哲学
D. n. 哲学；人生哲学（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 哲学之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的哲学之事）
F. n. 哲学；人生哲学（指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一门）
G. n. 哲学、智慧（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 智慧（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the philosophy that no visitor in the studio would have noted
The philosophy, meaning the thought itself and not the brush
Every sort of philosophy in that studio
the philosophy at the far easel
the philosophy was the whole of the matter
the philosophy had become a line in a catalogue
The philosophy of the whole thing

answers.why: teach the philosophy 意为“讲授这一门哲学”，1957 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯记下的一门哲学做了一遍。
philosophy 意为“哲学；人生哲学”，指那门哲学本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。
philosophy 意为“哲学；人生哲学”，指画室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
philosophy 意为“哲学；人生哲学”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
philosophy 意为“哲学、智慧”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门智慧就是那件事的全部。
philosophy 意为“智慧”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门哲学，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
philosophy 意为“哲学；人生哲学”，指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一门，到 1962 年这一门成了展品目录里的一行。
philosophy 意为“哲学之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的哲学之事是一处画室和三个季度的记下。
philosophy 意为“哲学；人生哲学”，我记得的是展品目录里记下过的那一门，1964 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一门。
philosophy 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，哲学是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的哲学。
